title: Watch Me Build an AI Agency in 24 Minutes
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The host is seeking customers for his own Repeat Leads service and promotes Playmakers AI. He also strongly endorses GoHighLevel; the transcript does not state whether he has an affiliation with that platform.

stated_problem.quote: It'll help you quote more jobs and never miss a call.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: AI voice agents for roofing businesses
idea.one_liner: Customise and operate an AI phone agent for roofing contractors; the agent answers questions and schedules inspections, with an expected recurring monthly fee.
idea.customer: Roofing contractors, especially local owner-operated businesses.
idea.offer: A customised, 24/7 AI voice agent that answers common questions and helps callers arrange a roof inspection or quote.
idea.revenue_model: Recurring monthly service fee; the host expects hundreds or thousands of dollars per month but has no customers yet in this experiment.

key_quotes.quote: Roofers are used to paying other agencies hundreds to thousands of dollars a month for stuff like this, especially if it can help them get more jobs.
I'm not going to send the roofer the link or the phone number to this AI voice agent until I have a roofer say yes.
Most questions will revolve around getting a quote and setting up an appointment for an inspection.
It'll help you quote more jobs and never miss a call.
Right now, before I have zero yeses, zero customers, I need to do whatever I can do just to get them to pay attention to me.

acquisition_channels.details: Scrapes roofing businesses, filters for mobile numbers, then sends personalised texts from his phone via Straight Text.
He considers having the AI agent call the scraped prospects proactively, then following up with a text.

ideas.delivery: Builds a customised voice agent in GoHighLevel, creates a roofing FAQ knowledge base with ChatGPT, connects a local phone number, tests calls, and passes usage costs on to the client.

prices: hundreds or thousands of dollars per month (expected service fee)
a buck 50 to 10 bucks (lead scrape estimate)
free for 100 calls a month or 10 calls a month (trial scenarios)

uk_legal_risk.reason: The described acquisition relies on cold SMS to scraped mobile numbers. In the UK, unsolicited marketing texts to individuals and sole traders are banned under PECR; the list is not screened by business legal form.

ideas.other_uk_rules: For UK use, apply UK GDPR requirements to scraped contact data, screen live marketing calls against TPS/CTPS, and obtain prior consent before automated marketing calls.
